text: We knew now down that the Ethiopians were a colony Modern of Cushines; that the Cushies were originally sovereigns of Ethiopie Shame and Charles, and consequently spoke other Chaldaic, _burgues_ - or a dialect of the tongue that their colonies must have used the same languages; and that the ancient Ethiopians were a people highly published, and celebrated in the next early ages on account of their virtue and piety. It has ever appeared that the citizens letters of that people were the sacred characters of the Companies. These letters, we incing, were the Cupile (; for some account ofwhich see the section on the Arabic). When the way were descendants, and the modern letters substituted in their room, cannot be deter- mined; nor is it, we apprehend, a matter of much importance. We shall therefore say that part of the subject, and refer our curious and impulsive readers to the favored Jod Ladol's excellent grammen and dictionary of the Abyssian or ees tongue; where they will find every thing worth knowing or that subject. We shall endeavour to grafity on readers with a very brief account of the modern Ethnic of Avisosion tonges, few whatso we are principally indebted to that learned, indetatigable, and adventurous travelice. Bruce , who, by his observations on that country, which he made in person, often at the board of hisft, has discovered, as it were, a new world both to Europe and Asia.
